name: Vivien Reid Emblem — keyword list ending ', and indestructible'
notes: Memory: project_emblem_indestructible_fixes_2026-05-11. The keyword split left 'and indestructible' as the last fragment so the final keyword was dropped. The emblem gives creatures you control +2/+2 and vigilance, trample, and indestructible, so Bears are 4/4 with all three.
